name: Backtest Results for a Simple Reversal Strategy
timeframe: daily signal candle implied by 'today' versus 'yesterday'; execution timeframe unknown
entry_rule: Setup only: today's candle has both a lower low and a lower high than yesterday's candle. Entry side, trigger, and timestamp are unknown.
required_data: daily OHLC derived causally from one-minute bars
nq_mnq_compatibility: The setup can be computed from NQ/MNQ OHLCV, but the source strategy cannot be reproduced because all execution and exit rules are absent.
lookahead_risks: using the current day's final high/low before the daily candle closes
entering at the same close without an executable next-bar rule
execution_risks: overnight gap between completed daily signal and executable entry
unknown stop behavior and session boundary
credibility_flags: source vintage is retrospective to tested history
distinctness: Partly overlaps prior failed-breakout/reversal candidates C15 and opening reversal controls, but operates on a daily two-candle state rather than an intraday level.
priority_rationale: Simple and potentially diversifying, but not specifiable without the missing entry and exit rules. Do not substitute invented defaults.

name: Simple mean reversion with IBS filter
instrument: equities in source; NQ/MNQ adaptation would be new research
entry_rule: At a completed daily close: close < (10-day high - 2.5 * (25-day average high - 25-day average low)) and IBS < 0.3. Whether entry is at that close or next session is unknown.
nq_mnq_compatibility: Indicators are computable now, but the equity claim does not transfer to NQ/MNQ and the source strategy is materially incomplete.
lookahead_risks: same-close execution after computing close-based IBS
daily high/low windows must exclude unavailable future values
execution_risks: futures roll discontinuities in daily ranges
credibility_flags: reported win rate is not evidence
distinctness: Related to prior Bollinger/VWAP mean-reversion candidates C04 and C12, but uses a daily IBS/range threshold rather than intraday bands.
priority_rationale: Potentially diversifying daily mean reversion, but source rules and futures applicability are insufficient for formal specification.

name: ADX/DMI trend-strength strategy
instrument: S&P 500 in source; NQ/MNQ would be an adaptation
entry_rule: Concept only: use DMI/ADX to measure trend strength. Thresholds, DI direction logic, and trigger are unknown.
required_data: one-minute OHLCV resampled to a frozen timeframe
complete DMI/ADX formula and trade rules
nq_mnq_compatibility: ADX and DMI are OHLC-derived and compatible, but no exact source strategy is available to test.
lookahead_risks: choosing thresholds after inspecting all years
distinctness: A trend-regime filter is distinct from prior pure price-level entries, but overlaps EMA trend candidates C05/C06 and should be tested as a pre-registered filter, not a free optimization axis.
priority_rationale: Mechanically computable and useful as a bounded regime hypothesis, but exact source rules are unavailable.

name: Connors RSI2 strategy
instrument: futures mentioned; exact tested instruments unknown
timeframe: unknown; likely multi-day from the name, but the bundle does not establish it
entry_rule: The bundle states that the strategy uses RSI with period 2 and three indicators; the other indicators, thresholds, direction, and trigger are unknown.
required_data: OHLC bars at the eventual frozen timeframe
nq_mnq_compatibility: RSI2 is computable from existing prices, but there are many materially different 'Connors RSI2' variants and the bundle does not identify one fully.
lookahead_risks: selecting among canonical variants after seeing results
credibility_flags: well-known name must not be used to fill missing rules from memory
distinctness: A short-horizon oscillator mean-reversion family differs from the prior intraday opening/level slate and could reduce dependence on rare breakout winners.
priority_rationale: Best strategy-family follow-up after operations work because it is simple and diversifying, but formalization must wait for a complete supplied rule set.

name: Bollinger-band close-to-middle mean reversion
instrument: SPY in source; NQ/MNQ adaptation would be new research
entry_rule: Buy SPY when a completed daily close is below the lower Bollinger band; execution timestamp is unknown.
target_rule: Exit after a completed daily close above the Bollinger middle band; execution timestamp is unknown.
required_data: complete band parameters and fill convention
nq_mnq_compatibility: The rule family is computable, but the exact source variant is incomplete and its SPY behavior cannot be assumed for futures.
lookahead_risks: trading at the close that creates the signal
execution_risks: unbounded adverse excursion without a stop
distinctness: Highly correlated with prior C04 Bollinger reversion and broader C12 VWAP mean-reversion family; should be grouped rather than counted as independent support.
priority_rationale: Duplicate family with missing parameters; only useful as background for a bounded daily-versus-intraday comparison.

name: Longer-horizon trend following with OBV context

entry_rule: Concept only: longer-timeframe trend following with an on-balance-volume calculation. Exact trend rule, OBV formula use, thresholds, and trigger are unknown.
nq_mnq_compatibility: Price and volume inputs are available, subject to continuous-futures volume/roll auditing, but the source rules are not reproducible from the bundle.
credibility_flags: linked code was not included or verified
distinctness: Materially different from the intraday Daytrading slate and the strongest diversification hypothesis in this bundle, although it overlaps C06 at the broad moving-average-trend level.
priority_rationale: Highest strategic interest because slower trend exposure may diversify opening strategies, but no exact variant may be invented from this bundle.

name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck statistical-arbitrage implementation
instrument: a mean-reverting security or spread; exact pair unknown
entry_rule: Concept only: model a tradeable price/spread as an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process and derive analytic entry/exit thresholds. Exact series, estimation window, and thresholds are unknown.
target_rule: OU-derived close threshold concept; exact rule unknown
required_data: timestamp-aligned second economically related futures series
point-in-time contract mappings for both legs
complete OU calibration and trade rules
nq_mnq_compatibility: NQ and MNQ are the same underlying exposure and do not form a useful statistical-arbitrage pair. A valid adaptation needs another related futures market; single-NQ price is not a faithful substitute.
distinctness: Genuinely distinct from the Daytrading slate, but not testable as a single-market NQ strategy and not supported by current data.
priority_rationale: Potential diversification value, but it requires a new market-data series and a fully specified, pre-registered spread model.

name: Prospective fill-quality degradation monitor
entry_rule: Not an alpha entry: log the causal intended order price/time and compare it with simulated and realized fill price/time.
stop_rule: Pause new entries when a frozen rolling slippage/reconciliation threshold is breached; numeric threshold is unknown and must be pre-registered from paper data.
target_rule: Restore eligibility only after reconciliation is clean and an explicit reviewed reset is recorded.
time_exit: Evaluate at every order event and session close.
position_sizing: No increase; fail closed or reduce to zero when breached.
nq_mnq_compatibility: Directly useful to NQ/MNQ, but needs a small prospective broker/paper event stream rather than historical market data.
lookahead_risks: using revised broker records without preserving originals
distinctness: New operational control, not another correlated signal. It addresses the largest uncovered path between research and live use.
priority_rationale: Highest-value next build because it produces the prospective evidence needed to calibrate execution and safe promotion without touching 2026 market outcomes.

name: Frozen strategy-degradation shutdown overlay
entry_rule: Permit a frozen strategy only while data health, execution quality, and performance remain within pre-registered warning/pause bands.
stop_rule: Set strategy allocation to zero on a hard breach; exact thresholds are unknown until a prospective protocol is specified.
target_rule: No profit target; this is a risk state machine.
time_exit: Immediate on an operational hard breach; performance reviews only at frozen session-count checkpoints.
position_sizing: active allocation, reduced allocation, or zero; no discretionary increase after losses.
lookahead_risks: restarting after inspecting favorable future recovery
credibility_flags: thresholds are not supplied by the bundle
distinctness: New risk control that can reduce damage from decay; it is not evidence that any strategy is profitable.
priority_rationale: Formalize after the event/fill ledger so every pause decision is causal, reproducible, and auditable.
